title: Riso Lane CLI — maintainer riso CLI and unit tests

questions.prompt: When this lane runs under /goal, what should it prioritize first?
questions.description: CLI already exposes doctor, validate, copy, update, recopy, diff, variants, catalog, prompts, export under src/riso with tests in tests/unit/test_cli. No maintainer riso-mcp.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Agent reliability baseline: keep JSON envelopes, exit codes, template-path resolution, and timeouts solid; green doctor --json and tests/unit/test_cli; only touch behavior with matching tests.

questions.prompt: Confirm write ownership boundaries for this lane.
questions.description: src/riso includes cli/, core/, and template/ helpers (hooks_runner, copier worker). Generated project Typer CLI under template/files/python is PY lane. scripts/ci is PLATFORM.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Own all of src/riso/** and tests/unit/test_cli/**. Read template/ and samples/ freely. Never write template payload, copier.yml, hooks, web/, samples answers/renders, or scripts/ci (except avoid even tiny CI edits unless unavoidable).

questions.prompt: If CLI work discovers a Copier/prompt/hook/catalog contract gap, what should happen?
questions.description: Lane must not reintroduce riso-mcp or invent template contracts.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Write a COORD handoff; keep CLI resilient/compatible without editing template/copier.yml, hooks, macros, or module_catalog. Prefer CLI code/tests fixes.

questions.prompt: What verification is required before calling the lane done?
questions.description: Prefer narrowest green checks first; just quality only if broader maintainer Python surfaces change.
questions.recommendedAnswer: uv run pytest tests/unit/test_cli/ -q; uv run riso doctor --json; exercise catalog/prompts/variants when those commands change; just quality only if needed.
